commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a 16 MiB combined stdout/stderr cap to `runSshSandboxCommand` and adds focused Vitest coverage for over-limit SSH sandbox output.

PR surface: Source +34, Tests +149. Total +183 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. Current main appends every SSH stdout/stderr chunk until close, and the PR body includes a real child-process negative control showing 20 MiB buffered on main; I did not run a live SSH OOM scenario in this read-only review.

target.title: fix(sandbox): bound SSH command output buffering at 16 MiB
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `runSshSandboxCommand` in `src/agents/sandbox/ssh.ts` accumulates remote command stdout/stderr into unbounded `Buffer[]` arrays. A runaway or misconfigured remote command that produces excessive output can exhaust the gateway process memory, leading to OOM.

## Why This Change Was Made

Two-part fix at the chokepoint (`runSshSandboxCommand`):

1. **Default safety cap (16 MiB):** Combined stdout+stderr byte tracking in the `data` event handlers. When exceeded, the child process is killed and the promise rejects with a descriptive error that carries the accumulated partial output.

2. **Configurable via `maxOutputBytes`:** Added to `RunSshSandboxCommandParams`. Defaults to 16 MiB; set to `0` to disable the cap entirely. Callers with legitimate large-output needs (e.g. reading a large remote file) can opt out without changing the default safety behavior for all other call sites.

This follows the defensive bounding pattern used elsewhere (`MAX_POST_TOOL_CALL_BUFFER_BYTES`, pending Anthropic SSE response-bound PR). The existing `SandboxBackendCommandResult` interface is unchanged.

## User Impact

- **Before:** A remote SSH command producing >16 MiB of output could grow the gateway heap unboundedly until OOM.
- **After:** Default cap at 16 MiB kills the process and surfaces a clear error. Callers that legitimately need more output set `maxOutputBytes` explicitly, e.g. `{ maxOutputBytes: 0 }` to disable or `{ maxOutputBytes: 64 * 1024 * 1024 }` for a larger cap.

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior addressed
Verify that `runSshSandboxCommand` kills a real child process and rejects with a byte-limit error when output exceeds the cap.

### Real environment tested
- OS: Linux x64, Node.js v24
- Method: independent `.mts` proof script driving `runSshSandboxCommand` with a real child process (no mocked `spawn`)

### Evidence after fix (real child process, 20 MiB output)

```
$ node --import tsx proof-ssh-output-cap.mts
=== FIX APPLIED (real child process, 20 MiB output) ===

error: Command output exceeded 16777216 byte limit
stdout buffered before kill: 15.96 MiB
  ok: error mentions byte limit
  ok: partial output preserved
  ok: captured under 17 MiB (cap active)

=== Summary ===
ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS: 3 passed, 0 failed
```

### Negative control (pre-fix main code, same script)

```
$ git show origin/main:src/agents/sandbox/ssh.ts > src/agents/sandbox/ssh.ts
$ node --import tsx proof-ssh-output-cap.mts
=== NEGATIVE CONTROL (pre-fix main code) ===

exit code: 0
stdout buffered: 20.0 MiB (unbounded)
  ok: output exceeds 16 MiB (no cap)
  ok: exit code is 0 (completed normally)

=== Summary ===
ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS: 2 passed, 0 failed
```

Before the fix: 20 MiB buffered silently. After: killed at ~16 MiB with clear error + partial output preserved.

## Evidence

### Vitest (mocked spawn — external dep only)

```
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sandbox/ssh.output-bound.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  7 passed (7)

$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/sandbox/ssh.test.ts --run
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  28 passed (28)
```

New test coverage (7 cases):
| Case | Result |
|------|--------|
| Normal output (<16 MiB) | collected, resolves |
| Single chunk >16 MiB | killed, rejects with byte-limit error |
| Many small chunks crossing 16 MiB | cap triggers on combined total |
| Partial output preserved in error | stdout/stderr buffers carried on error |
| Post-cap data ignored | chunks after `outputCapped=true` not accumulated |
| Custom `maxOutputBytes: 1 MiB` | respects custom cap, kills at 1 MiB |
| `maxOutputBytes: 0` (disabled) | no cap, 20 MiB resolves normally |

### Lint & types

- `check-lint`: pass
- `check-test-types`: pass
- All `checks-node-compact-*` shards: pass

AI-assisted.
